stages.summary: Specifications, tooling and the first verified building blocks. Each one is complete as a component.
The real-time core: timing, execution and the checked hand-off between the control process and the data plane.
Fronthaul packet I/O, and the integration of the core components into one running O-RU.
Validation against a real DU, with the virtual radio in place of radio hardware.
Measurement on the real radio bench, under the same conditions as the reference baseline.
Directions beyond the first measured end-to-end result. None of them is scheduled.
